message: When `keys` is empty (e.g. OPENROUTER_API_KEYS not set), `keyCount` is clamped to 1 and the loop fires one unauthenticated request (empty Bearer token) instead of failing fast.
Rate-limit log always references `_kiloKeyIndex` even when the caller is an OpenRouter request, so the logged key index is wrong for OpenRouter calls.

`usedModel` is derived by scanning `allModels` for the first non-skipped entry, but `callKilo` may internally fall through several models; the model pushed into `emptyRetries` may not be the one that actually returned the empty response, causing the wrong model to be blacklisted.

In the streaming retry path, `sseContentBlockStart` is written to the client before the empty/junk check; if the response is junk the stream continues with an unmatched `content_block_start` (and its paired `content_block_stop` at line 1015) emitted mid-stream before the retry, corrupting the SSE protocol for the downstream client.

`JSON.parse(tc.function.arguments || '{}')` in the built-in tool execution loop is not wrapped in a try/catch, so malformed JSON arguments crash the entire non-streaming handler with an unhandled exception.

When `available.length === 0` and `nudgeUsed` is false, the nudge message is appended and `failedModels` cleared, but execution falls through into the same-iteration `callKilo` call with `skipModels=[]`; if that call also fails the nudge counter is not incremented until the next iteration, risking one extra full model-sweep beyond the intended limit.
